name: Bent-Knee Hip Raise
instructions: Lay flat on the floor with your arms next to your sides.
Bend your knees to about a 75 degree angle and lift your feet off the floor by a couple inches. This is the starting position.
Using your lower abs, bring your knees in toward you, rolling your pelvis backward until your hips lift off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top for a second, then return to the starting position slowly.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
